Browser libraries for the file-browser Office preview (static/office-viewer.js). Do not edit; replace as a set.
mammoth 1.8.0 (BSD-2-Clause)  https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js   - .docx -> HTML
SheetJS xlsx 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0) https://github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs        - .xlsx/.xlsm/.xls reader
JSZip 3.10.1 (MIT)            https://github.com/Stuk/jszip                - .pptx is a zip of XML
All of them run in the visitor's browser; nothing is converted on the server.
